33/// A callback function for resolving font queries.
34///
35/// The first argument is the raw data, the second argument is the index in case the font
36/// is a TTC, otherwise it should be 0.
37pub type FontResolverFn = Arc<dyn Fn(&FontQuery) -> Option<(FontData, u32)> + Send + Sync>;
38/// A callback function for resolving cmap names to their files.
39pub type CMapResolverFn = Arc<dyn Fn(crate::third_party::hayro_cmap::CMapName<'_>) -> Option<&'static [u8]> + Send + Sync>;
40/// A callback function for resolving warnings during interpretation.
41pub type WarningSinkFn = Arc<dyn Fn(InterpreterWarning) + Send + Sync>;
42
43#[derive(Clone)]
44/// Settings that should be applied during the interpretation process.
45pub struct InterpreterSettings {
46    /// Nearly every PDF contains text. In most cases, PDF files embed the fonts they use, and
47    /// hayro can therefore read the font files and do all the processing needed. However, there
48    /// are two problems:
49    /// - Fonts don't _have_ to be embedded, it's possible that the PDF file only defines the basic
50    ///   metadata of the font, like its name, but relies on the PDF processor to find that font
51    ///   in its environment.
52    /// - The PDF specification requires a list of 14 fonts that should always be available to a
53    ///   PDF processor. These include:
54    ///   - Times New Roman (Normal, Bold, Italic, `BoldItalic`)
55    ///   - Courier (Normal, Bold, Italic, `BoldItalic`)
56    ///   - Helvetica (Normal, Bold, Italic, `BoldItalic`)
57    ///   - `ZapfDingBats`
58    ///   - Symbol
59    ///
60    /// Because of this, if any of the above situations occurs, this callback will be called, which
61    /// expects the data of an appropriate font to be returned, if available. If no such font is
62    /// provided, the text will most likely fail to render.
63    ///
64    /// For the font data, there are two different formats that are accepted:
65    /// - Any valid TTF/OTF font.
66    /// - A valid CFF font program.
67    ///
68    /// The following recommendations are given for the implementation of this callback function.
69    ///
70    /// For the standard fonts, in case the original fonts are available on the system, you should
71    /// just return those. Otherwise, for Helvetica, Courier and Times New Roman, the best alternative
72    /// are the corresponding fonts of the [Liberation font family](https://github.com/liberationfonts/liberation-fonts).
73    /// If you prefer smaller fonts, you can use the [Foxit CFF fonts](https://github.com/LaurenzV/hayro/tree/master/assets/standard_fonts),
74    /// which are much smaller but are missing glyphs for certain scripts.
75    ///
76    /// For the `Symbol` and `ZapfDingBats` fonts, you should also prefer the system fonts, and if
77    /// not available to you, you can, similarly to above, use the corresponding fonts from Foxit.
78    ///
79    /// If you don't want having to deal with this, you can just enable the `embed-fonts` feature
80    /// and use the default implementation of the callback.
81    pub font_resolver: FontResolverFn,
82    /// A callback for resolving cmaps that aren't embedded.
83    ///
84    /// When the PDF requires using a cmap that is not directly embedded in the PDF,
85    /// this callback will be called to attempt fetching the data of the file.
86    ///
87    /// When the `embed-cmaps` feature is enabled, this uses `load_embedded`
88    /// method from `hayro-cmap` by default, which embeds the cmap files for
89    /// all 61 predefined cmaps
90    /// that the PDF specification requires to be readily available on a system.
91    /// Otherwise, you can implement your custom logic for lazily fetching the
92    /// data. If you are fine not supporting such PDFs, you can simply pass a closure
93    /// that always returns `None`.
94    pub cmap_resolver: CMapResolverFn,
95    /// In certain cases, `hayro` will emit a warning in case an issue was encountered while interpreting
96    /// the PDF file. Providing a callback allows you to catch those warnings and handle them, if desired.
97    pub warning_sink: WarningSinkFn,
98    /// Whether annotations should be rendered as well.
99    ///
100    /// Note that this feature is currently not fully implemented yet, so some
101    /// annotations might be missing.
102    pub render_annotations: bool,
103    /// PdfCraft patch: hide comments (markup annotations) but keep form fields (`/Widget`)
104    /// and links, for the viewer's "Hide all comments".
105    pub hide_comments: bool,
106    /// PdfCraft patch: viewer overrides for optional content groups (object number, generation,
107    /// visible), applied on top of the document's default configuration (Layers panel toggles).
108    pub ocg_overrides: Arc<Vec<(i32, i32, bool)>>,
109    /// PdfCraft patch (103): apply the default configuration's auto state for the View event
110    /// (`/AS` usage applications with `/Event /View`, ISO 32000-2 §8.11.4.4) before
111    /// `ocg_overrides`. On by default: that is the state for viewing. Off for output made for
112    /// printing, which the View event is not.
113    pub view_auto_state: bool,
114    /// PdfCraft patch (105): viewer overrides for annotations (object number, generation, shown),
115    /// applied in place of their Hidden and NoView flags: what a document's scripts show and
116    /// hide while it is read (frames of an animation), without changing the document.
117    pub annotation_overrides: Arc<Vec<(i32, i32, bool)>>,
118    /// PdfCraft patch (106): annotations the viewer draws with a form XObject as their normal
119    /// appearance (object number and generation of the annotation, then of the form), in their
120    /// own `/Rect`: a push button a document's script gave another icon (`buttonSetIcon`) while
121    /// it is read, without changing the document. An override naming an object that isn't a form
122    /// draws nothing (the script cleared the icon).
123    pub appearance_overrides: Arc<Vec<(i32, i32, i32, i32)>>,
124    /// PdfCraft patch: once this is `true`, interpretation stops before the next content
125    /// operator. What was drawn is then incomplete, so only set it when the output will be
126    /// thrown away (a viewer's render whose result nobody can receive any more).
127    pub cancelled: Option<Arc<AtomicBool>>,
128    /// PdfCraft patch: a low-detail render for previews (page backdrops, thumbnails). Images
129    /// that would cover only a few device pixels are skipped: redrawing them at full detail
130    /// costs a decode and a resample each for pixels nobody can see. Never set it for a final
131    /// render (tiles, whole pages, print, export).
132    pub preview: bool,
133    /// PdfCraft patch (73): the steps of JBIG2 decoding a page's images may take between them
134    /// ([`crate::third_party::hayro_syntax::MAX_PAGE_JBIG2_WORK`] by default). Images past it aren't drawn, nor images
135    /// whose masks are past it, each with [`InterpreterWarning::ContentTruncated`].
136    pub jbig2_work: u64,
137}
138
139impl Default for InterpreterSettings {
140    fn default() -> Self {
141        Self {
142            #[cfg(any())]
143            font_resolver: Arc::new(|_| None),
144            font_resolver: Arc::new(|query| match query {
145                FontQuery::Standard(s) => Some(s.get_font_data()),
146                FontQuery::Fallback(f) => Some(f.pick_standard_font().get_font_data()),
147            }),
148            cmap_resolver: Arc::new(crate::third_party::hayro_cmap::load_embedded),
149            #[cfg(any())]
150            cmap_resolver: Arc::new(|_| None),
151            warning_sink: Arc::new(|_| {}),
152            render_annotations: true,
153            hide_comments: false,
154            ocg_overrides: Arc::new(Vec::new()),
155            view_auto_state: true,
156            annotation_overrides: Arc::new(Vec::new()),
157            appearance_overrides: Arc::new(Vec::new()),
158            cancelled: None,
159            preview: false,
160            jbig2_work: crate::third_party::hayro_syntax::MAX_PAGE_JBIG2_WORK,
161        }
162    }
163}

165#[derive(Copy, Clone, Debug)]
166/// Warnings that can occur while interpreting a PDF file.
167pub enum InterpreterWarning {
168    /// An unsupported font kind was encountered.
169    ///
170    /// Currently, only CID fonts with non-identity encoding are unsupported.
171    UnsupportedFont,
172    /// An image failed to decode.
173    ImageDecodeFailure,
174    /// PdfCraft patch (18): a page content stream was skipped after exhausting its safety budget.
175    /// Patch (73): or an image was left out for the page's JBIG2 allowance, or because its JBIG2
176    /// mask is past the allowance or one of the decoder's limits.
177    ContentTruncated,
178    /// PdfCraft patch (55): a colour could not be computed (a colour space that cannot be
179    /// read, or a Separation or DeviceN tint transform that cannot be evaluated) and was painted
180    /// in a fallback colour. Reported at most once per content stream.
181    ColorFallback,
182    /// PdfCraft patch (80): an image's `/Indexed` colour space is malformed (ISO 32000-2
183    /// §8.6.6.3). The image was drawn recovered (indices past a short lookup table in black, a
184    /// `hival` past 255 taken as 255, a real one truncated), or, with a `hival` below zero or not a
185    /// number, in DeviceGray; with no lookup table at all it was not drawn.
186    MalformedIndexedImage,
187    /// PdfCraft patch (90): a Type 3 font without `/Widths` (or `/FirstChar`/`/LastChar`),
188    /// which ISO 32000-2 Table 110 requires, was selected; its glyphs advance by the widths
189    /// their glyph procedures set with `d0`/`d1`. Reported each time such a font is selected.
190    Type3WidthsMissing,
191}

193/// PdfCraft patch (73): ends a page's JBIG2 allowance with the page, so that what decodes on its
194/// thread afterwards has no page to run out on.
195struct PageJbig2Work;
196
197impl Drop for PageJbig2Work {
198    fn drop(&mut self) {
199        crate::third_party::hayro_syntax::set_page_jbig2_work(u64::MAX);
200    }
201}

203/// interpret the contents of the page and render them into the device.
204pub fn interpret_page<'a>(page: &Page<'a>, context: &mut Context<'a>, device: &mut impl Device<'a>) {
205    // PdfCraft patch (73): a context used again is another page.
206    crate::third_party::hayro_syntax::set_page_jbig2_work(context.settings.jbig2_work);
207    let _allowance = PageJbig2Work;
208    let resources = page.resources();
209    let mut content = page.content_reader();
210    // PdfCraft patch: the page's own contents count against its content budget too, where they
211    // are decoded whole. Streamed content is only ever held a window at a time.
212    crate::third_party::hayro_interpret::context::charge_content(content.materialized_len());
213    interpret_content(&mut content, resources, context, device);
214
215    if context.settings.render_annotations
216        && let Some(annot_arr) = page.raw().get::<Array<'_>>(ANNOTS)
217    {
218        // PdfCraft patch (29): bracket the annotations so devices can tell their paints from
219        // the document's own (the reading-colours setting recolours the document, not comments).
220        device.begin_annotations();
221        // PdfCraft patch (86): form fields' widgets are drawn after the page's other
222        // annotations, each group in `/Annots` order, as other readers draw them: a filled
223        // comment listed after a check box covered the box. ISO 32000-2 doesn't order the two.
224        // Two passes over the array, so nothing is held for every entry of a long one.
225        // PdfCraft patch (105): each annotation with its object, so the viewer can show or hide
226        // it by its object (`annotation_overrides`). An entry that isn't a dictionary is
227        // skipped; it no longer ends the list.
228        let xref = context.xref;
229        for widgets in [false, true] {
230            let annots = annot_arr.raw_iter().filter_map(|item| match item {
231                crate::third_party::hayro_syntax::object::MaybeRef::Ref(r) => xref.get::<Dict<'_>>(r.into()).map(|d| (d, Some(r))),
232                crate::third_party::hayro_syntax::object::MaybeRef::NotRef(Object::Dict(d)) => Some((d, None)),
233                crate::third_party::hayro_syntax::object::MaybeRef::NotRef(_) => None,
234            });
235            for (annot, obj) in annots {
236                if (annot.get::<crate::third_party::hayro_syntax::object::Name<'_>>(SUBTYPE).as_deref() == Some(b"Widget")) != widgets {
237                    continue;
238                }
239                let flags = annot.get::<u32>(F).unwrap_or(0);
240
241                // Annotation should be hidden (Hidden = bit 2, NoView = bit 6).
242                // PdfCraft patch: NoView was not honoured upstream.
243                // PdfCraft patch (105): the viewer's override, when it has one, decides instead.
244                let overridden = obj.and_then(|r| {
245                    context
246                        .settings
247                        .annotation_overrides
248                        .iter()
249                        .find(|(num, generation, _)| *num == r.obj_number && *generation == r.gen_number)
250                        .map(|(_, _, shown)| !*shown)
251                });
252                if overridden.unwrap_or(flags & (2 | 32) != 0) {
253                    continue;
254                }
255                // PdfCraft patch (56): Invisible (bit 1) hides an annotation of a type that isn't one
256                // of the standard ones (ISO 32000-2 Table 167), and a popup has no appearance of its
257                // own (§12.5.6.14): the viewer shows it as a window for its parent, not on the page.
258                let subtype = annot.get::<crate::third_party::hayro_syntax::object::Name<'_>>(SUBTYPE);
259                if subtype.as_deref() == Some(b"Popup") || (flags & 1 != 0 && !subtype.as_deref().is_some_and(is_standard_annotation_type)) {
260                    continue;
261                }
262                // PdfCraft patch (81): a reply of type R (a markup annotation with an `/IRT` to the
263                // annotation it answers and an `/RT` other than `/Group`; R is the default, so a
264                // missing, unknown or malformed `/RT` reads as R) is not drawn, whatever its
265                // appearance or flags: "Interactive PDF processors shall not display replies to an
266                // annotation individually but together in the form of threaded comments" (ISO 32000-2
267                // Table 172). A `/RT /Group` member is part of its group's look and still draws.
268                // `/IRT` is a markup annotation's entry: a widget, link or pop-up with one still draws.
269                if !matches!(
270                    annot.get::<crate::third_party::hayro_syntax::object::Name<'_>>(SUBTYPE).as_deref(),
271                    Some(b"Widget" | b"Link" | b"Popup")
272                ) && annot.get::<Dict<'_>>(IRT).is_some()
273                    && annot.get::<crate::third_party::hayro_syntax::object::Name<'_>>(RT).as_deref() != Some(b"Group")
274                {
275                    continue;
276                }
277                // PdfCraft patch: "Hide all comments" keeps widgets and links.
278                if context.settings.hide_comments
279                    && !matches!(annot.get::<crate::third_party::hayro_syntax::object::Name<'_>>(SUBTYPE).as_deref(), Some(b"Widget" | b"Link"))
280                {
281                    continue;
282                }
283
284                // PdfCraft patch: `/N` may be a stream or a dictionary of appearance states selected
285                // by `/AS` (checkboxes, radio buttons, …). Upstream only handled the stream form.
286                // PdfCraft patch (106): the viewer may draw it with another form instead
287                // (`appearance_overrides`).
288                // An override naming an object that isn't a form draws nothing: a script cleared the
289                // button's icon.
290                let face = obj.and_then(|r| {
291                    context.settings.appearance_overrides.iter().find(|(num, generation, _, _)| *num == r.obj_number && *generation == r.gen_number)
292                });
293                let normal = match face {
294                    Some(&(_, _, num, generation)) => {
295                        xref.get::<Stream<'_>>(crate::third_party::hayro_syntax::object::ObjectIdentifier::new(num, generation))
296                    }
297                    None => annot.get::<Dict<'_>>(AP).and_then(|ap| {
298                        ap.get::<Stream<'_>>(N).or_else(|| {
299                            let states = ap.get::<Dict<'_>>(N)?;
300                            let state = annot.get::<crate::third_party::hayro_syntax::object::Name<'_>>(AS)?;
301                            states.get::<Stream<'_>>(state.as_ref())
302                        })
303                    }),
304                };
305                if let Some(apx) = normal.and_then(|o| FormXObject::new(&o)) {
306                    let Some(rect) = annot.get::<Rect>(RECT) else {
307                        continue;
308                    };
309
310                    let annot_rect = rect.to_kurbo();
311                    // 12.5.5. Appearance streams
312                    // "The algorithm outlined in this subclause shall be used
313                    // to map from the coordinate system of the appearance XObject."
314
315                    // 1) The appearance’s bounding box (specified by its BBox entry)
316                    // shall be transformed, using Matrix, to produce a
317                    // quadrilateral with arbitrary orientation. The transformed
318                    // appearance box is the smallest upright rectangle that
319                    // encompasses this quadrilateral.
320                    let transformed_rect = (apx.matrix
321                        * kurbo::Rect::new(apx.bbox[0] as f64, apx.bbox[1] as f64, apx.bbox[2] as f64, apx.bbox[3] as f64).to_path(0.1))
322                    .bounding_box();
323
324                    // 2) A matrix A shall be computed that scales and translates
325                    // the transformed appearance box to align with the edges
326                    // of the annotation’s rectangle (specified by the Rect entry).
327                    // A maps the lower-left corner (the corner with the smallest
328                    // x and y coordinates) and the upper-right corner (the
329                    // corner with the greatest x and y coordinates) of the
330                    // transformed appearance box to the corresponding corners
331                    // of the annotation’s rectangle.
332                    // PdfCraft patch: the translation is taken after scaling (it was
333                    // `/Rect.x0 - box.x0`, right only for a box at the origin or a scale of 1).
334                    let (sx, sy) = (annot_rect.width() / transformed_rect.width(), annot_rect.height() / transformed_rect.height());
335                    let affine = Affine::new([sx, 0.0, 0.0, sy, annot_rect.x0 - sx * transformed_rect.x0, annot_rect.y0 - sy * transformed_rect.y0]);
336                    // PdfCraft patch (59): NoRotate (bit 5) keeps the appearance upright as the page is
337                    // displayed (ISO 32000-2 §12.5.3).
338                    let affine =
339                        if flags & 16 != 0 && no_rotate_applies(&annot) { no_rotate_turn(page.rotation(), &annot_rect) * affine } else { affine };
340
341                    // PdfCraft patch: a /BBox or /Matrix that collapses the appearance box to a line
342                    // or a point leaves nothing to map onto /Rect: the scales above divide by zero,
343                    // and the infinite or NaN matrix reached the device with everything the
344                    // appearance draws. Clipped to such a box the appearance shows nothing, so skip
345                    // it, as when the mapping overflows.
346                    if !(transformed_rect.is_finite() && transformed_rect.width() > 0.0 && transformed_rect.height() > 0.0 && affine.is_finite()) {
347                        continue;
348                    }
349
350                    // 3) Matrix shall be concatenated with A to form a matrix
351                    // AA that maps from the appearance’s coordinate system to
352                    // the annotation’s rectangle in default user space.
353                    context.save_state();
354                    context.pre_concat_affine(affine);
355                    context.push_root_transform();
356
357                    draw_form_xobject(resources, &apx, context, device);
358                    context.pop_root_transform();
359                    context.restore_state(device);
360                } else if annot.get::<crate::third_party::hayro_syntax::object::Name<'_>>(SUBTYPE).as_deref() == Some(b"Highlight") {
361                    // PdfCraft patch: a Highlight without a usable normal appearance was not drawn.
362                    draw_highlight_without_appearance(&annot, context, device);
363                }
364            }
365        }
366        device.end_annotations();
367    }
368}

370/// PdfCraft patch (56): whether `subtype` is one of the standard annotation types of
371/// ISO 32000-2 Table 171.
372fn is_standard_annotation_type(subtype: &[u8]) -> bool {
373    matches!(
374        subtype,
375        b"Text"
376            | b"Link"
377            | b"FreeText"
378            | b"Line"
379            | b"Square"
380            | b"Circle"
381            | b"Polygon"
382            | b"PolyLine"
383            | b"Highlight"
384            | b"Underline"
385            | b"Squiggly"
386            | b"StrikeOut"
387            | b"Caret"
388            | b"Stamp"
389            | b"Ink"
390            | b"Popup"
391            | b"FileAttachment"
392            | b"Sound"
393            | b"Movie"
394            | b"Screen"
395            | b"Widget"
396            | b"PrinterMark"
397            | b"TrapNet"
398            | b"Watermark"
399            | b"3D"
400            | b"Redact"
401            | b"Projection"
402            | b"RichMedia"
403    )
404}

406/// PdfCraft patch (59): whether the NoRotate flag turns this annotation's appearance. Form fields
407/// and links are left in `/Rect`: PdfCraft takes their click targets from it.
408fn no_rotate_applies(annot: &Dict<'_>) -> bool {
409    !matches!(annot.get::<crate::third_party::hayro_syntax::object::Name<'_>>(SUBTYPE).as_deref(), Some(b"Widget" | b"Link"))
410}
411
412/// PdfCraft patch (59): the user-space turn that keeps a NoRotate annotation upright on a page
413/// with `/Rotate`. The page is shown turned clockwise, so the appearance (already fitted to
414/// `/Rect`) is turned as far counterclockwise about the rectangle's upper-left corner, which stays
415/// where it is on the page (ISO 32000-2 §12.5.3). Its width then runs across the displayed page
416/// and its height down from that corner.
417fn no_rotate_turn(rotation: Rotation, rect: &kurbo::Rect) -> Affine {
418    let (cos, sin) = match rotation {
419        Rotation::None => return Affine::IDENTITY,
420        Rotation::Horizontal => (0.0, 1.0),
421        Rotation::Flipped => (-1.0, 0.0),
422        Rotation::FlippedHorizontal => (0.0, -1.0),
423    };
424    let (x, y) = (rect.x0.min(rect.x1), rect.y0.max(rect.y1));
425    Affine::new([cos, sin, -sin, cos, x - (cos * x - sin * y), y - (sin * x + cos * y)])
426}
427
428/// PdfCraft patch: the normal appearance of a Highlight annotation that has none (ISO 32000-2
429/// §12.5.6.10), drawn as PdfCraft draws its own highlights (pdfcraft-annot): each /QuadPoints
430/// quadrilateral filled with /C at /CA opacity, blended with Multiply so the marked-up content
431/// stays legible. /QuadPoints that aren't groups of eight numbers, or a /C that isn't a gray, RGB
432/// or CMYK colour (absent or empty means transparent), draw nothing.
433fn draw_highlight_without_appearance<'a>(annot: &Dict<'a>, context: &mut Context<'a>, device: &mut impl Device<'a>) {
434    let numbers = |key| -> Option<Vec<f32>> {
435        annot
436            .get::<Array<'_>>(key)?
437            .iter::<Object<'_>>()
438            .map(|o| match o {
439                Object::Number(n) => Some(n.as_f32()),
440                _ => None,
441            })
442            .collect()
443    };
444    let Some(quad_points) = numbers(QUADPOINTS).filter(|q| !q.is_empty() && q.len() % 8 == 0) else {
445        return;
446    };
447    let (color_space, color) = match numbers(C).as_deref() {
448        Some(&[g]) => (ColorSpace::device_gray(), smallvec![g]),
449        Some(&[r, g, b]) => (ColorSpace::device_rgb(), smallvec![r, g, b]),
450        Some(&[c, m, y, k]) => (ColorSpace::device_cmyk(), smallvec![c, m, y, k]),
451        _ => return,
452    };
453
454    let mut path = BezPath::new();
455    // Corners in /QuadPoints order: upper left, upper right, lower left, lower right.
456    for &[x1, y1, x2, y2, x3, y3, x4, y4] in quad_points.as_chunks::<8>().0 {
457        path.move_to((x1 as f64, y1 as f64));
458        path.line_to((x2 as f64, y2 as f64));
459        path.line_to((x4 as f64, y4 as f64));
460        path.line_to((x3 as f64, y3 as f64));
461        path.close_path();
462    }
463
464    context.save_state();
465    let state = &mut context.get_mut().graphics_state;
466    state.none_stroke_cs = color_space;
467    state.non_stroke_color = color;
468    state.non_stroke_pattern = None;
469    state.non_stroke_alpha = annot.get::<f32>(CA).unwrap_or(1.0).clamp(0.0, 1.0);
470    state.soft_mask = None;
471    state.blend_mode = BlendMode::Multiply;
472    *context.path_mut() = path;
473    fill_path(context, device, FillRule::NonZero);
474    context.restore_state(device);
475}
476
477/// PdfCraft patch (38): the colour space `cs` or `CS` selects by `name`: a device space, else
478/// the `/ColorSpace` resource `name`. A device space, named directly or by a resource, is
479/// replaced by its default from `defaults` (ISO 32000-2 §8.6.5.6).
480fn named_color_space<'a>(
481    name: &crate::third_party::hayro_syntax::object::Name<'_>,
482    resources: &Resources<'a>,
483    defaults: &DefaultColorSpaces<'_, '_>,
484    context: &mut Context<'a>,
485) -> Option<ColorSpace> {
486    if let Some(named) = ColorSpace::new_from_name(name) {
487        let default = DeviceFamily::of_name(name).and_then(|family| defaults.get(family));
488        return Some(default.map_or(named, |(space, _)| space));
489    }
490    let resource = resources.get_color_space(name);
491    if let Some((space, _)) = resource.as_ref().and_then(DeviceFamily::of_object).and_then(|family| defaults.get(family)) {
492        return Some(space);
493    }
494    context.get_color_space(resources, name)
495}
496
497/// Interprets the instructions that `ops` yields, until they run out or the caller cancels. It runs
498/// once per window of a content stream, between one `save_state` and its restore (see
499/// `interpret_content`).
500fn interpret_window<'a>(ops: &mut TypedIter<'_>, resources: &Resources<'a>, context: &mut Context<'a>, device: &mut impl Device<'a>) {
501    // PdfCraft patch (38): the resources' DefaultGray, DefaultRGB and DefaultCMYK replace the
502    // device spaces that colour operators and images select (ISO 32000-2 §8.6.5.6).
503    let defaults = DefaultColorSpaces::new(resources, &context.interpreter_cache.object_cache);
504    while let Some(op) = ops.next() {
505        // PdfCraft patch: stop when the caller cancelled (see `InterpreterSettings::cancelled`).
506        if context.settings.cancelled.as_ref().is_some_and(|c| c.load(Ordering::Relaxed)) {
507            break;
508        }
509        match op {
510            TypedInstruction::SaveState(_) => context.save_state(),
511            // PdfCraft patch (68): in a form or an appearance stream, a `Q` with no `q` of that
512            // stream to match is ignored, so it cannot pop the states of the content that drew
513            // it. Page content keeps its old behaviour (`stream_floor` stays 0 there).
514            TypedInstruction::RestoreState(_) if context.stream_floor_reached() => {
515                warn!("ignored a `Q` with no matching `q` in its content stream");
516            }
517            TypedInstruction::StrokeColorDeviceRgb(s) => {
518                // PdfCraft patch (38): DeviceRGB, or the DefaultRGB that replaces it.
519                context.get_mut().graphics_state.stroke_cs = defaults.device(DeviceFamily::Rgb);
520                context.get_mut().graphics_state.stroke_color = smallvec![s.0.as_f32(), s.1.as_f32(), s.2.as_f32()];
521                context.get_mut().graphics_state.stroke_pattern = None;
522            }
523            TypedInstruction::StrokeColorDeviceGray(s) => {
524                // PdfCraft patch (38): DeviceGray, or the DefaultGray that replaces it.
525                context.get_mut().graphics_state.stroke_cs = defaults.device(DeviceFamily::Gray);
526                context.get_mut().graphics_state.stroke_color = smallvec![s.0.as_f32()];
527                context.get_mut().graphics_state.stroke_pattern = None;
528            }
529            TypedInstruction::StrokeColorCmyk(s) => {
530                // PdfCraft patch (38): DeviceCMYK, or the DefaultCMYK that replaces it.
531                context.get_mut().graphics_state.stroke_cs = defaults.device(DeviceFamily::Cmyk);
532                context.get_mut().graphics_state.stroke_color = smallvec![s.0.as_f32(), s.1.as_f32(), s.2.as_f32(), s.3.as_f32()];
533                context.get_mut().graphics_state.stroke_pattern = None;
534            }
535            TypedInstruction::LineWidth(w) => {
536                // PdfCraft patch (61): see `convert_line_width`.
537                context.get_mut().graphics_state.stroke_props.line_width = convert_line_width(w.0.as_f32());
538            }
539            TypedInstruction::LineCap(c) => {
540                context.get_mut().graphics_state.stroke_props.line_cap = convert_line_cap(c);
541            }
542            TypedInstruction::LineJoin(j) => {
543                context.get_mut().graphics_state.stroke_props.line_join = convert_line_join(j);
544            }
545            TypedInstruction::MiterLimit(l) => {
546                context.get_mut().graphics_state.stroke_props.miter_limit = l.0.as_f32();
547            }
548            TypedInstruction::Transform(t) => {
549                context.pre_concat_transform(t);
550            }
551            TypedInstruction::RectPath(r) => {
552                let rect = kurbo::Rect::new(r.0.as_f64(), r.1.as_f64(), r.0.as_f64() + r.2.as_f64(), r.1.as_f64() + r.3.as_f64()).to_path(0.1);
553                context.path_mut().extend(rect);
554            }
555            TypedInstruction::MoveTo(m) => {
556                let p = Point::new(m.0.as_f64(), m.1.as_f64());
557                *(context.last_point_mut()) = p;
558                *(context.sub_path_start_mut()) = p;
559                context.path_mut().move_to(p);
560            }
561            TypedInstruction::FillPathEvenOdd(_) => {
562                fill_path(context, device, FillRule::EvenOdd);
563            }
564            TypedInstruction::FillPathNonZero(_) => {
565                fill_path(context, device, FillRule::NonZero);
566            }
567            TypedInstruction::FillPathNonZeroCompatibility(_) => {
568                fill_path(context, device, FillRule::NonZero);
569            }
570            TypedInstruction::FillAndStrokeEvenOdd(_) => {
571                fill_stroke_path(context, device, FillRule::EvenOdd);
572            }
573            TypedInstruction::FillAndStrokeNonZero(_) => {
574                fill_stroke_path(context, device, FillRule::NonZero);
575            }
576            TypedInstruction::CloseAndStrokePath(_) => {
577                close_path(context);
578                stroke_path(context, device);
579            }
580            TypedInstruction::CloseFillAndStrokeEvenOdd(_) => {
581                close_path(context);
582                fill_stroke_path(context, device, FillRule::EvenOdd);
583            }
584            TypedInstruction::CloseFillAndStrokeNonZero(_) => {
585                close_path(context);
586                fill_stroke_path(context, device, FillRule::NonZero);
587            }
588            TypedInstruction::NonStrokeColorDeviceGray(s) => {
589                // PdfCraft patch (38): DeviceGray, or the DefaultGray that replaces it.
590                context.get_mut().graphics_state.none_stroke_cs = defaults.device(DeviceFamily::Gray);
591                context.get_mut().graphics_state.non_stroke_color = smallvec![s.0.as_f32()];
592                context.get_mut().graphics_state.non_stroke_pattern = None;
593            }
594            TypedInstruction::NonStrokeColorDeviceRgb(s) => {
595                // PdfCraft patch (38): DeviceRGB, or the DefaultRGB that replaces it.
596                context.get_mut().graphics_state.none_stroke_cs = defaults.device(DeviceFamily::Rgb);
597                context.get_mut().graphics_state.non_stroke_color = smallvec![s.0.as_f32(), s.1.as_f32(), s.2.as_f32()];
598                context.get_mut().graphics_state.non_stroke_pattern = None;
599            }
600            TypedInstruction::NonStrokeColorCmyk(s) => {
601                // PdfCraft patch (38): DeviceCMYK, or the DefaultCMYK that replaces it.
602                context.get_mut().graphics_state.none_stroke_cs = defaults.device(DeviceFamily::Cmyk);
603                context.get_mut().graphics_state.non_stroke_color = smallvec![s.0.as_f32(), s.1.as_f32(), s.2.as_f32(), s.3.as_f32()];
604                context.get_mut().graphics_state.non_stroke_pattern = None;
605            }
606            TypedInstruction::LineTo(m) => {
607                if !context.path().elements().is_empty() {
608                    begin_subpath_after_close(context);
609                    // PdfCraft patch (61): a segment to the point it starts from is kept as it
610                    // is. Upstream nudged its end a ten-thousandth of a point to the right so
611                    // round caps drew a dot, which also gave butt and square caps a direction
612                    // to draw in; `stroke_path_impl` now handles degenerate subpaths.
613                    let p = Point::new(m.0.as_f64(), m.1.as_f64());
614                    *(context.last_point_mut()) = p;
615
616                    context.path_mut().line_to(p);
617                }
618            }
619            TypedInstruction::CubicTo(c) => {
620                if !context.path().elements().is_empty() {
621                    begin_subpath_after_close(context);
622                    let p1 = Point::new(c.0.as_f64(), c.1.as_f64());
623                    let p2 = Point::new(c.2.as_f64(), c.3.as_f64());
624                    let p3 = Point::new(c.4.as_f64(), c.5.as_f64());
625
626                    *(context.last_point_mut()) = p3;
627
628                    context.path_mut().curve_to(p1, p2, p3);
629                }
630            }
631            TypedInstruction::CubicStartTo(c) => {
632                if !context.path().elements().is_empty() {
633                    begin_subpath_after_close(context);
634                    let p1 = *context.last_point();
635                    let p2 = Point::new(c.0.as_f64(), c.1.as_f64());
636                    let p3 = Point::new(c.2.as_f64(), c.3.as_f64());
637
638                    *(context.last_point_mut()) = p3;
639
640                    context.path_mut().curve_to(p1, p2, p3);
641                }
642            }
643            TypedInstruction::CubicEndTo(c) => {
644                if !context.path().elements().is_empty() {
645                    begin_subpath_after_close(context);
646                    let p2 = Point::new(c.0.as_f64(), c.1.as_f64());
647                    let p3 = Point::new(c.2.as_f64(), c.3.as_f64());
648
649                    *(context.last_point_mut()) = p3;
650
651                    context.path_mut().curve_to(p2, p3, p3);
652                }
653            }
654            TypedInstruction::ClosePath(_) => {
655                close_path(context);
656            }
657            TypedInstruction::SetGraphicsState(gs) => {
658                if let Some(gs) = resources.get_ext_g_state(gs.0).warn_none(&format!("failed to get extgstate {}", gs.0.as_str())) {
659                    handle_gs(&gs, context, resources);
660                }
661            }
662            TypedInstruction::StrokePath(_) => {
663                stroke_path(context, device);
664            }
665            TypedInstruction::EndPath(_) => {
666                apply_pending_clip(context, device);
667                context.path_mut().truncate(0);
668            }
669            TypedInstruction::NonStrokeColor(c) => {
670                let gs = &mut context.get_mut().graphics_state;
671                gs.non_stroke_color = c.0.into_iter().map(|n| n.as_f32()).collect();
672                gs.non_stroke_pattern = None;
673            }
674            TypedInstruction::StrokeColor(c) => {
675                let gs = &mut context.get_mut().graphics_state;
676                gs.stroke_color = c.0.into_iter().map(|n| n.as_f32()).collect();
677                gs.stroke_pattern = None;
678            }
679            TypedInstruction::ClipNonZero(_) => {
680                *(context.clip_mut()) = Some(FillRule::NonZero);
681            }
682            TypedInstruction::ClipEvenOdd(_) => {
683                *(context.clip_mut()) = Some(FillRule::EvenOdd);
684            }
685            TypedInstruction::RestoreState(_) => context.restore_state(device),
686            TypedInstruction::FlatnessTolerance(_) => {
687                // Ignore for now.
688            }
689            TypedInstruction::ColorSpaceStroke(c) => {
690                // PdfCraft patch (38): see `named_color_space`.
691                // PdfCraft patch (55): a space that cannot be read is drawn in DeviceGray, as
692                // before, and the fallback is reported.
693                // PdfCraft patch (80): an Indexed space with no lookup table counts as one that
694                // cannot be read, as upstream.
695                let cs = named_color_space(c.0, resources, &defaults, context).filter(|cs| !cs.is_tableless_indexed()).unwrap_or_else(|| {
696                    crate::third_party::hayro_interpret::color::note_color_fallback();
697                    ColorSpace::device_gray()
698                });
699                // PdfCraft patch (80): so is an Indexed space drawn recovered (indices past a
700                // short table drawn black, a `hival` clamped or truncated; see `Indexed::new`).
701                if cs.is_recovered_indexed() {
702                    crate::third_party::hayro_interpret::color::note_color_fallback();
703                }
704
705                if !cs.is_pattern() {
706                    context.get_mut().graphics_state.stroke_pattern = None;
707                }
708                context.get_mut().graphics_state.stroke_color = cs.initial_color();
709                context.get_mut().graphics_state.stroke_cs = cs;
710            }
711            TypedInstruction::ColorSpaceNonStroke(c) => {
712                // PdfCraft patch (38): see `named_color_space`.
713                // PdfCraft patch (55): a space that cannot be read is drawn in DeviceGray, as
714                // before, and the fallback is reported.
715                // PdfCraft patch (80): an Indexed space with no lookup table counts as one that
716                // cannot be read, as upstream.
717                let cs = named_color_space(c.0, resources, &defaults, context).filter(|cs| !cs.is_tableless_indexed()).unwrap_or_else(|| {
718                    crate::third_party::hayro_interpret::color::note_color_fallback();
719                    ColorSpace::device_gray()
720                });
721                // PdfCraft patch (80): so is an Indexed space drawn recovered (indices past a
722                // short table drawn black, a `hival` clamped or truncated; see `Indexed::new`).
723                if cs.is_recovered_indexed() {
724                    crate::third_party::hayro_interpret::color::note_color_fallback();
725                }
726
727                if !cs.is_pattern() {
728                    context.get_mut().graphics_state.non_stroke_pattern = None;
729                }
730                context.get_mut().graphics_state.non_stroke_color = cs.initial_color();
731                context.get_mut().graphics_state.none_stroke_cs = cs;
732            }
733            TypedInstruction::DashPattern(p) => {
734                context.get_mut().graphics_state.stroke_props.dash_offset = p.1.as_f32();
735                // PdfCraft patch (61): see `convert_dash_array`.
736                context.get_mut().graphics_state.stroke_props.dash_array = convert_dash_array(p.0.iter::<f32>());
737            }
738            TypedInstruction::RenderingIntent(_) => {
739                // Ignore for now.
740            }
741            TypedInstruction::NonStrokeColorNamed(n) => {
742                context.get_mut().graphics_state.non_stroke_color = n.0.into_iter().map(|n| n.as_f32()).collect();
743                context.get_mut().graphics_state.non_stroke_pattern =
744                    n.1.and_then(|name| resources.get_pattern(name).and_then(|d| Pattern::new(d, context, resources, &defaults)));
745            }
746            TypedInstruction::StrokeColorNamed(n) => {
747                context.get_mut().graphics_state.stroke_color = n.0.into_iter().map(|n| n.as_f32()).collect();
748                context.get_mut().graphics_state.stroke_pattern =
749                    n.1.and_then(|name| resources.get_pattern(name).and_then(|d| Pattern::new(d, context, resources, &defaults)));
750            }
751            TypedInstruction::BeginMarkedContentWithProperties(bdc) => {
752                // Properties can be either:
753                // 1. A Name that references an entry in the Resources/Properties dictionary
754                // 2. An inline dictionary with an OC key
755
756                let mcid = dict_or_stream(bdc.1).and_then(|(props, _)| props.get::<i32>(MCID));
757
758                let oc = bdc
759                    .1
760                    .clone()
761                    .into_name()
762                    .and_then(|name| {
763                        let r = resources.properties.get_ref(name.as_ref())?;
764                        let d = resources.properties.get::<Dict<'_>>(name).unwrap_or_default();
765                        Some((d, r))
766                    })
767                    .or_else(|| {
768                        let (props, _) = dict_or_stream(bdc.1)?;
769                        let r = props.get_ref(OC)?;
770                        let d = props.get::<Dict<'_>>(OC).unwrap_or_default();
771                        Some((d, r))
772                    });
773
774                if let Some((dict, oc_ref)) = oc {
775                    context.ocg_state.begin_ocg(&dict, oc_ref.into());
776                } else {
777                    context.ocg_state.begin_marked_content();
778                }
779
780                device.begin_marked_content(bdc.0, mcid);
781
782                // PdfCraft patch (25): hand the device the sequence's `/ActualText`, from an inline
783                // property list or one named in the resources' `/Properties`.
784                let actual = dict_or_stream(bdc.1)
785                    .map(|(props, _)| props.clone())
786                    .or_else(|| {
787                        let name = bdc.1.clone().into_name()?;
788                        resources.properties.get::<Dict<'_>>(name)
789                    })
790                    .and_then(|props| props.get::<crate::third_party::hayro_syntax::object::String<'_>>(ACTUAL_TEXT));
791                if let Some(text) = actual {
792                    device.actual_text(text.as_bytes());
793                }
794            }
795            TypedInstruction::MarkedContentPointWithProperties(_) => {}
796            TypedInstruction::EndMarkedContent(_) => {
797                context.ocg_state.end_marked_content();
798                device.end_marked_content();
799            }
800            TypedInstruction::MarkedContentPoint(_) => {}
801            TypedInstruction::BeginMarkedContent(bmc) => {
802                context.ocg_state.begin_marked_content();
803                device.begin_marked_content(bmc.0, None);
804            }
805            TypedInstruction::BeginText(_) => {
806                context.get_mut().text_state.text_matrix = Affine::IDENTITY;
807                context.get_mut().text_state.text_line_matrix = Affine::IDENTITY;
808            }
809            TypedInstruction::SetTextMatrix(m) => {
810                let m = Affine::new([m.0.as_f64(), m.1.as_f64(), m.2.as_f64(), m.3.as_f64(), m.4.as_f64(), m.5.as_f64()]);
811                context.get_mut().text_state.text_line_matrix = m;
812                context.get_mut().text_state.text_matrix = m;
813            }
814            TypedInstruction::EndText(_) => {
815                let has_outline = context.get().text_state.clip_paths.segments().next().is_some();
816
817                if has_outline {
818                    let clip_path = context.get().ctm * context.get().text_state.clip_paths.clone();
819
820                    context.push_clip_path(clip_path, FillRule::NonZero, device);
821                }
822
823                context.get_mut().text_state.clip_paths.truncate(0);
824            }
825            TypedInstruction::TextFont(t) => {
826                let name = t.0;
827
828                // In case we are unable to resolve the font, two scenarios:
829                // 1) If the font doesn't exist in the first place in the resource dictionary,
830                // assume Helvetica (this seems to be what other PDF viewers do).
831                // 2) In case it's `None` because we were unable to resolve the font
832                // (for whatever reason), leave it as `None`. Better showing no
833                // text at all than garbage text.
834                let font = if let Some(font_dict) = resources.get_font(name) {
835                    context.resolve_font(&font_dict)
836                } else {
837                    Font::new_standard(StandardFont::Helvetica, &context.settings.font_resolver).map(TextStateFont::Fallback)
838                };
839
840                context.get_mut().text_state.font_size = t.1.as_f32();
841                context.get_mut().text_state.font = font;
842            }
843            TypedInstruction::ShowText(s) => {
844                if context.get().text_state.font.is_none() {
845                    // Even if no explicit font was set, we try to assume Helvetica. Acrobat
846                    // seems to do the same.
847                    context.get_mut().text_state.font =
848                        Font::new_standard(StandardFont::Helvetica, &context.settings.font_resolver).map(TextStateFont::Fallback);
849                }
850
851                text::show_text_string(context, device, resources, s.0);
852            }
853            TypedInstruction::ShowTexts(s) => {
854                if context.get().text_state.font.is_none() {
855                    // Even if no explicit font was set, we try to assume Helvetica. Acrobat
856                    // seems to do the same.
857                    context.get_mut().text_state.font =
858                        Font::new_standard(StandardFont::Helvetica, &context.settings.font_resolver).map(TextStateFont::Fallback);
859                }
860
861                for obj in s.0.iter::<Object<'_>>() {
862                    match obj {
863                        Object::Number(num) => {
864                            context.get_mut().text_state.apply_adjustment(num.as_f32());
865                        }
866                        Object::String(text) => {
867                            text::show_text_string(context, device, resources, &text);
868                        }
869                        _ => {}
870                    }
871                }
872            }
873            TypedInstruction::HorizontalScaling(h) => {
874                context.get_mut().text_state.horizontal_scaling = h.0.as_f32();
875            }
876            TypedInstruction::TextLeading(tl) => {
877                context.get_mut().text_state.leading = tl.0.as_f32();
878            }
879            TypedInstruction::CharacterSpacing(c) => {
880                context.get_mut().text_state.char_space = c.0.as_f32();
881            }
882            TypedInstruction::WordSpacing(w) => {
883                context.get_mut().text_state.word_space = w.0.as_f32();
884            }
885            TypedInstruction::NextLine(n) => {
886                let (tx, ty) = (n.0.as_f64(), n.1.as_f64());
887                text::next_line(context, tx, ty);
888            }
889            TypedInstruction::NextLineUsingLeading(_) => {
890                text::next_line(context, 0.0, -context.get().text_state.leading as f64);
891            }
892            TypedInstruction::NextLineAndShowText(n) => {
893                text::next_line(context, 0.0, -context.get().text_state.leading as f64);
894                text::show_text_string(context, device, resources, n.0);
895            }
896            TypedInstruction::TextRenderingMode(r) => {
897                let mode = match r.0.as_i64() {
898                    0 => TextRenderingMode::Fill,
899                    1 => TextRenderingMode::Stroke,
900                    2 => TextRenderingMode::FillStroke,
901                    3 => TextRenderingMode::Invisible,
902                    4 => TextRenderingMode::FillAndClip,
903                    5 => TextRenderingMode::StrokeAndClip,
904                    6 => TextRenderingMode::FillAndStrokeAndClip,
905                    7 => TextRenderingMode::Clip,
906                    _ => {
907                        warn!("unknown text rendering mode {}", r.0.as_i64());
908
909                        TextRenderingMode::Fill
910                    }
911                };
912
913                context.get_mut().text_state.render_mode = mode;
914            }
915            TypedInstruction::NextLineAndSetLeading(n) => {
916                let (tx, ty) = (n.0.as_f64(), n.1.as_f64());
917                context.get_mut().text_state.leading = -ty as f32;
918                text::next_line(context, tx, ty);
919            }
920            TypedInstruction::ShapeGlyph(_) => {}
921            TypedInstruction::XObject(x) => {
922                let cache = context.interpreter_cache.object_cache.clone();
923                // PdfCraft patch: decoded images are cached per quality (preview or final).
924                let decoded_cache = context.interpreter_cache.decoded_cache.for_render(context.settings.preview);
925                let transfer_function = context.get().graphics_state.transfer_function.clone();
926                if let Some(x_object) = resources.get_x_object(x.0).and_then(|s| {
927                    XObject::new(
928                        &s,
929                        &context.settings.warning_sink,
930                        &cache,
931                        Some(&decoded_cache),
932                        transfer_function.clone(),
933                        // PdfCraft patch (38): an image in a device space draws in its default.
934                        &defaults,
935                    )
936                }) {
937                    draw_xobject(&x_object, resources, context, device);
938                }
939            }
940            TypedInstruction::InlineImage(i) => {
941                let warning_sink = context.settings.warning_sink.clone();
942                let transfer_function = context.get().graphics_state.transfer_function.clone();
943                let cache = context.interpreter_cache.object_cache.clone();
944                // PdfCraft patch (80): an inline image naming a resource colour space that is an
945                // Indexed space whose `hival` has no reading is reported, as `ImageXObject::new`
946                // reports one given in place; the image falls back as upstream. Only the array's
947                // name and `hival` are read here, never its lookup table: a recovered space is
948                // reported by `ImageXObject::new` from the space it builds through the resource
949                // cache. A device space name (or its inline abbreviation) never refers to a
950                // resource (ISO 32000-2 §8.6.8), and `ImageXObject::new` takes it first, so a
951                // resource of that name is not consulted.
952                let inline_dict = i.0.dict();
953                if inline_dict
954                    .get::<crate::third_party::hayro_syntax::object::Name<'_>>(crate::third_party::hayro_syntax::object::dict::keys::CS)
955                    .or_else(|| {
956                        inline_dict.get::<crate::third_party::hayro_syntax::object::Name<'_>>(
957                            crate::third_party::hayro_syntax::object::dict::keys::COLORSPACE,
958                        )
959                    })
960                    .filter(|name| ColorSpace::new_from_name(name).is_none())
961                    .and_then(|name| resources.get_color_space(&name))
962                    .is_some_and(|cs| crate::third_party::hayro_interpret::color::has_unusable_hival(&cs))
963                {
964                    warning_sink(InterpreterWarning::MalformedIndexedImage);
965                }
966                // PdfCraft patch: inline images are not cached (see `DecodedImageKey`).
967                // PdfCraft patch (38): an inline image in a device space, named directly or by a
968                // resource, draws in its default.
969                if let Some(x_object) = ImageXObject::new(
970                    i.0,
971                    |name| named_color_space(name, resources, &defaults, context),
972                    &warning_sink,
973                    &cache,
974                    None,
975                    false,
976                    transfer_function,
977                    Some(&defaults),
978                ) {
979                    draw_image_xobject(&x_object, context, device);
980                }
981            }
982            TypedInstruction::TextRise(t) => {
983                context.get_mut().text_state.rise = t.0.as_f32();
984            }
985            TypedInstruction::Shading(s) => {
986                if !context.ocg_state.is_visible() {
987                    continue;
988                }
989
990                let transfer_function = context.get().graphics_state.transfer_function.clone();
991
992                if let Some(sp) = resources
993                    .get_shading(s.0)
994                    .and_then(|o| {
995                        let (dict, stream) = dict_or_stream(&o)?;
996                        // PdfCraft patch (38): a shading in a device space draws in its default.
997                        Shading::new(dict, stream, &context.interpreter_cache.object_cache, &defaults)
998                    })
999                    .map(|s| {
1000                        Pattern::Shading(ShadingPattern {
1001                            shading: Arc::new(s),
1002                            matrix: Affine::IDENTITY,
1003                            opacity: context.get().graphics_state.non_stroke_alpha,
1004                            transfer_function: transfer_function.clone(),
1005                        })
1006                    })
1007                {
1008                    context.save_state();
1009                    context.push_root_transform();
1010                    let st = context.get_mut();
1011                    st.graphics_state.non_stroke_pattern = Some(sp);
1012                    st.graphics_state.none_stroke_cs = ColorSpace::pattern();
1013
1014                    device.set_soft_mask(st.graphics_state.soft_mask.clone());
1015                    device.set_blend_mode(st.graphics_state.blend_mode);
1016
1017                    let bbox = context.bbox().to_path(0.1);
1018                    let inverted_bbox = context.get().ctm.inverse() * bbox;
1019                    fill_path_impl(context, device, FillRule::NonZero, Some(&inverted_bbox));
1020
1021                    context.pop_root_transform();
1022                    context.restore_state(device);
1023                } else {
1024                    warn!("failed to process shading");
1025                }
1026            }
1027            TypedInstruction::BeginCompatibility(_) => {}
1028            TypedInstruction::EndCompatibility(_) => {}
1029            TypedInstruction::ColorGlyph(_) => {}
1030            TypedInstruction::ShowTextWithParameters(t) => {
1031                context.get_mut().text_state.word_space = t.0.as_f32();
1032                context.get_mut().text_state.char_space = t.1.as_f32();
1033                text::next_line(context, 0.0, -context.get().text_state.leading as f64);
1034                text::show_text_string(context, device, resources, t.2);
1035            }
1036            _ => {
1037                warn!("failed to read an operator");
1038            }
1039        }
1040    }
1041}
1042
1043/// Interpret the instructions from `ops` and render them into the device.
1044pub fn interpret<'a>(mut ops: TypedIter<'_>, resources: &Resources<'a>, context: &mut Context<'a>, device: &mut impl Device<'a>) {
1045    let num_states = context.num_states();
1046
1047    context.save_state();
1048    let outer_floor = context.enter_stream();
1049
1050    interpret_window(&mut ops, resources, context, device);
1051
1052    while context.num_states() > num_states {
1053        context.restore_state(device);
1054    }
1055    context.leave_stream(outer_floor);
1056    // PdfCraft patch (18): say that content was skipped, so a truncated page isn't a clean render.
1057    if crate::third_party::hayro_interpret::context::content_was_truncated() {
1058        (context.settings.warning_sink)(InterpreterWarning::ContentTruncated);
1059    }
1060    // PdfCraft patch (55): and that a colour was painted in a fallback colour.
1061    if crate::third_party::hayro_interpret::color::take_color_fallback() {
1062        (context.settings.warning_sink)(InterpreterWarning::ColorFallback);
1063    }
1064}
1065
1066/// PdfCraft patch: the bytes of a window of page content. A window grows only while an instruction
1067/// at its end is incomplete.
1068const CONTENT_WINDOW: usize = 64 << 10;
1069
1070/// PdfCraft patch: interprets the content of a page a window at a time, so the decoded content is
1071/// never all in memory (see `ContentReader`). A window ends at an instruction that is not complete
1072/// yet: its bytes are kept, and the next window starts with them.
1073fn interpret_content<'a>(content: &mut ContentReader<'_>, resources: &Resources<'a>, context: &mut Context<'a>, device: &mut impl Device<'a>) {
1074    let num_states = context.num_states();
1075
1076    context.save_state();
1077
1078    let mut window = Vec::with_capacity(CONTENT_WINDOW);
1079    let mut exhausted = false;
1080    let mut cut = false;
1081    loop {
1082        let (committed, needs_more) = {
1083            let mut ops = TypedIter::new_window(&window, exhausted);
1084            interpret_window(&mut ops, resources, context, device);
1085            (ops.committed(), ops.needs_more())
1086        };
1087        window.drain(..committed);
1088
1089        let cancelled = context.settings.cancelled.as_ref().is_some_and(|c| c.load(Ordering::Relaxed));
1090        if !needs_more || cancelled || exhausted {
1091            break;
1092        }
1093        // A window that is still incomplete at its end waits for more of the stream. It doubles
1094        // while it waits, so one long instruction costs time in proportion to its length, and it
1095        // stops growing at `MAX_DECODED_STREAM`, the most any one stream may decode to.
1096        if window.len() >= MAX_DECODED_STREAM {
1097            cut = true;
1098            break;
1099        }
1100        let want = window.len().max(CONTENT_WINDOW);
1101        if content.read_into(&mut window, want) == 0 {
1102            exhausted = true;
1103        }
1104    }
1105
1106    while context.num_states() > num_states {
1107        context.restore_state(device);
1108    }
1109    // PdfCraft patch (18): say that content was skipped, so a truncated page isn't a clean render.
1110    if cut || content.truncated() || crate::third_party::hayro_interpret::context::content_was_truncated() {
1111        (context.settings.warning_sink)(InterpreterWarning::ContentTruncated);
1112    }
1113    // PdfCraft patch (55): and that a colour was painted in a fallback colour.
1114    if crate::third_party::hayro_interpret::color::take_color_fallback() {
1115        (context.settings.warning_sink)(InterpreterWarning::ColorFallback);
1116    }
1117}
